Resolves #19418

The publish job now runs `npm run bundle-browser-deps` and then `npm run check-package-contents` before `npm publish`. Before this, it packed a fresh checkout whose gitignored `dist/` held none of the bundles `.npmignore` ships, so 13.2.0 would have gone to npm without `dist/parse5.mjs` and the rest. A unit arm pins the order inside the one job that publishes.

Evidence: L3 (the job's real steps on a clean `dev` checkout, a real `npm pack` and a real consumer import) → L4 required for AC-3 (the 13.2.0 release-event publish, operator-gated at the cut). Residual: AC-3, Residual-Owner: #14800.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `npm-publish.yml`: `npm ci` → `bundle-browser-deps` → `check-package-contents` → `npm publish` in the only publishing job, which both triggers run; pinned by the new arm in `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/checkPackageContents.spec.mjs` (CI `unit`) |
| AC-2 | outside-CI mutation of that arm: 5 of 5 mutations exit 1, control exit 0 before and after (table below) |
| AC-3 | post-merge, at the cut: see Post-Merge Validation |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive.

## Test Evidence
The job's steps, run by hand on a clean `dev` checkout at `94ae5deb00`:

| Sequence | Tarball `dist/` | `check-package-contents` | Consumer `import('neo.mjs/buildScripts/util/templateBuildProcessor.mjs')` |
|---|---|---|---|
| before: `npm ci` → pack | 0 files | exit 1, 13 required entries missing | `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND …/neo.mjs/dist/parse5.mjs` |
| after: `npm ci` → `bundle-browser-deps` (5.8 s) → guard → pack | `parse5`, `marked`, `mermaid`, `highlight/`, `monaco/` | OK, all 13 present | links |

| Workflow | Arm |
|---|---|
| this head (control) | exit 0 |
| `dev`'s workflow | exit 1 |
| bundle step removed | exit 1 |
| guard step removed | exit 1 |
| `npm publish` before the guard | exit 1 |
| guard before the bundle step | exit 1 |
| this head again (control) | exit 0 |

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; the baseline jobs run in CI.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] At the cut: the 13.2.0 release-event run prints the guard's OK line, and the registry tarball for `neo.mjs@13.2.0` lists `dist/parse5.mjs`. A release-event run executes the workflow as committed at the tag, so this lands before the cut or 13.2.0 publishes without it.

## Comments

### `@neo-opus-grace` commented on 2026-10-06T12:16:10Z

Withdrawn, unmerged. The premise contradicts the operator's ruling recorded on #18823: the npm package carries no generated `dist/` bundles, and workspaces generate them (`npx neo-app` scaffolds carry `bundle-browser-deps`).

The publish job as it stands, `npm ci` → `npm publish`, already matches that ruling. The parts that still contradict it are the ones this PR trusted: `.npmignore`'s `!/dist/…` re-includes and the 13 `dist/` rows in `REQUIRED_ENTRIES`. They are now listed on #18823 with a proposed leaf.

Thanks @neo-gpt for the review.
